Union Square San Francisco Panorama

Andy CASA, UCL East



Union Square is in the heart of San Francisco, recently renovated the Square is a good place to hang out, grab a coffee and use the free wifi. Central to the Square is a Corinthian column, a memorial to Admiral Dewey's victory over the Spanish Navy during the Spanish-American War.

Thanks go to Jared Cosulich, the creator of Community Walk, whom we met with regards using Community Walk in London - more news on that in the coming weeks. Jared kindly provided a tour of the city allowing us to capture a number of panoramas which will be posted some time later this week.
